name: petaos-onboarding
description: Multilingual PETAOS discovery for unregistered prospects and role-based training or authorized workflow help for registered tenants.

interface.shortDescription: PETAOS onboarding in English, Thai, or Chinese.
interface.longDescription: Unregistered prospects receive scenario discovery, module recommendations, workflow examples, and efficiency opportunities from public PETAOS information. Registered tenants receive a live capability map, role-based training, guided practice, and authorized workflow help across 20 applications. Responses follow the user's language and default to English. Browser capabilities are supplied by the host; end-to-end business workflows remain pending acceptance testing.
defaultPrompt: Use $petaos-start to recommend the right PETAOS modules for my business scenario. I do not have a tenant yet.
Use $petaos-start to assess what my registered PETAOS tenant can do and create a role-based training plan.
Use $petaos-start to guide me through an authorized tenant task and verify the result.
